name: Image-based TF Design
definition: A user-guided classification method where users draw scribbles on image slices to indicate Regions of Interest (ROIs), which are then classified using Random Forest on INR features to generate probabilistic volume rendering.
summary: Image-based TF Design automates volume rendering classification by training a Random Forest on scribble-labeled INR features, distinguishing itself by operating in 3D voxel space rather than mapping 2D sketches to 1D curves.
